sources: Input-length cap before regex compilation (concept: CWE-1333, inefficient regular expression complexity); history entry 3f8b2d1 and review RC-1
Producer/consumer limit agreement across modules (concept: writer and reader must share one batch limit); history entry 9c01e47 and review RC-2

defects.class: removed input guard before regex compilation
defects.description: Contradicts history entry 3f8b2d1 ("cap pattern input at 256 chars before regex search") and review RC-1 ("Every path that compiles a user pattern must run it first"). The change removes the _check_pattern_length(pattern) call from filter_features(), so the call at line 44 compiles and runs any pattern length. Failing input: filter_features([Feature('1','alpha',1.0,2.0)], 'a'*300). Base raises PatternError('pattern length 300 exceeds 256 characters'); code returns [] (computed by running both versions). The 256-character guard is no longer enforced on the review-screen path; search_names() still enforces it, so the regression is only visible by comparing the two functions or reading the history.

defects.class: batch size exceeds reader limit (cross-file contract)
defects.description: Contradicts history entry 9c01e47 ("limit feature file to 60 entries", producer FEATURES_PER_FILE = 60 and loader MAX_FEATURES = 60) and review RC-2 ("producer batch size and loader MAX_FEATURES must stay equal"). The change sets FEATURES_PER_FILE = 120 at line 15 while loader.py MAX_FEATURES (line 14 of code/loader.py, unchanged) stays 60. Failing input: write_feature_files('RUN-7', 120 features, out_dir) writes one file RUN-7-000.features.json with 120 rows (base wrote two files of 60). load_feature_file() on it raises FeatureFileError('RUN-7-000.features.json: 120 features exceeds limit 60') (computed); load_directory() returns {} and count_rejected() returns 1. Every batch of the run is rejected by the loader.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: search_names() calls _check_pattern_length(query) before _compile(query), so the 256-character guard is enforced on this path; it matches RC-1. Concrete check: a 300-character query raises PatternError here in both versions.

Slice range(0, len(features), size) with features[start:start + size] yields consecutive non-overlapping batches with no off-by-one: 120 features with size 60 gives starts 0 and 60, and the final partial batch is kept. Unchanged context.
The check uses '>' so exactly MAX_FEATURES (60) entries are accepted, which is the limit stated in history entry 9c01e47. A 60-row file loads in base and code (computed).

The except clause converts TypeError and ValueError from float() or str() into FeatureFormatError and chains the original with 'from exc'; the same conversion pattern as the loader. Correct for a non-numeric string value.

Unchanged line. A JSON NaN in retention_time is accepted by from_mapping() (json.load and float() both accept it; computed: NaN accepted in base and code), and sorted() with NaN keys gives an inconsistent order: [3.0, nan, 1.0] stays in input order (computed). The flaw exists before this change and is not on a line the change added or edited, so a diff-mode reviewer must not report it.
